title: CoderCruise 2019 - Call for Speakers
content:
Now for the 3rd year the team behind the original php[cruise] is bringing a conference to the open seas. will be a premiere conference experience, giving you an exclusive connection to your fellow community members. It will set sail from Port Canaveral on August 19th for a 5 day cruise that also visits Princess Cays and Nassau!CoderCruise 2019

Just like last year we've negotiated a low rate for our participants that is all inclusive, per person (including 5-day cruise, food, drink !)starting as low as $435and the conference

Our is open until March 3rd, and we invite you to send us your talk proposals. We want to hear from you, as do others!Call for Speakers
author: PHP.net news & announcements
